description: Top-N rows of one leaderboard (rank, stars, forks, issues, language, description). Refreshes every ~6 hours; generatedAt is the batch stamp (fetch once per sync cycle).

language.description: optional source-language facet; supported only for overall / weekly / monthly

name: get_board

degraded.description: true = the official Trending scrape failed and a Search-based fallback methodology was served; cite with care (HTML pages show the same warning)

score.description: Rising/dark boards: 7-day growth in percent (gained / window-start stars). Absolute-gain form on rising carries this too.

slope.description: Stars per day since repo creation (all-time average; rising/dark boards now use score instead)

source.description: github-search | github-trending | github-search-fallback — which upstream produced this batch

title: Get board snapshot
